purpose: Structured QA queue for alias, merge, composition, cast/show/soundtrack, worship, and traditional-song risks. This is not an automatic merge list.

safe_display_name_normalization.recommended_action: Normalize display aliases after confirming same entity.
Normalize display aliases after confirming same entity.
Normalize case; preserve source display names.
Confirm same artist and recording, then normalize display alias.
Confirm same artist identity and recording, then normalize.

likely_same_artist_entity.recommended_action: Create alias row; do not duplicate artist.
Create explicit alias table entries before hard lock.

examples: Larry Heard / Mr. Fingers / Fingers Inc.
likely_same_artist_entity.recommended_action: Human review; project aliases may be linked but not collapsed by default.

examples: Darius Rucker vs Hootie & the Blowfish
must_remain_separate.recommended_action: Keep separate canonical artists; link through relationship metadata later.

examples: U.S. Wailers vs Bob Marley & The Wailers
Jimmie Rodgers pop vs country Jimmie Rodgers

must_remain_separate.recommended_action: Keep separate composition IDs and recording IDs.

needs_human_review.recommended_action: Decide canonical entity and credit alias model.

examples: Gene Vincent and His Blue Caps
needs_human_review.recommended_action: Decide canonical entity and recording-credit model.

examples: Shania Twain - Man! I Feel Like a Woman!

composition_vs_recording_review.recommended_action: Keep recordings separate; link composition only after source review.

examples: Hank Ballard & The Midnighters - The Twist
Big Joe Turner - Shake, Rattle and Roll
Bill Haley & His Comets - Shake, Rattle and Roll
Arthur Big Boy Crudup - That's All Right

composition_vs_recording_review.recommended_action: Manual composition review; do not merge by title.

examples: The Animals - House of the Rising Sun
The Beach Boys - God Only Knows
for KING & COUNTRY - God Only Knows
composition_vs_recording_review.recommended_action: Review likely separate compositions; do not merge by title.

examples: Carolina Gaitan, Mauro Castillo, Adassa, Rhenzy Feliz, Diane Guerrero, Stephanie Beatriz and Encanto Cast
cast_show_soundtrack_review.recommended_action: Model film/show, cast recording, performers, and recording separately.

examples: Guardians of the Galaxy: Awesome Mix Vol. 1
cast_show_soundtrack_review.recommended_action: Separate score album, curated soundtrack album, and source song recordings.

examples: The Soggy Bottom Boys - Man of Constant Sorrow
cast_show_soundtrack_review.recommended_action: Preserve fictional performer credit; link traditional composition separately.

worship_traditional_review.recommended_action: Composition-first hymn model; preserve definitive recordings.
Keep brands and individual performers distinct until relationship table exists.
